Align migration versions and preferred identifier contract

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-23
  description: |-
    Raise the PostgreSQL migration version authority from 1..=111 to 1..=113 after renaming workspace aliases to 0113. Document that stored issues.identifier remains {workspace_key}-{number}, preferred output is derived from Workspace issue_prefix plus number, and get/search accept both forms through the shared resolver without bulk rewriting stored identifiers.
